verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a dedicated SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and lets you action policies, risks, and evidence. It ships pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection, AI evidence-gap checks, audit-partner selection, and in-platform auditor collaboration, which covers the core of running a SOC 2 program. missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II support, explicit mention of Trust Services Criteria mapping or built-in policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
